description: Add calibration instruction: for small-cap public companies with active equity programs, going-concern language, or capital needs, the default probability that share counts or cash balances cross a modest threshold within 3-6 months should be 0.75-0.90 unless materials contain strong contrary evidence, because equity issuances, warrant exercises, and financing events are routine and frequent. [round 2, Probability questions underestimated for small-cap equity/cash threshold crossing]
